questions.text: According to the narration, what distinguishes an AI agent from a traditional chatbot?
options: Only answer questions like a chatbot.
Execute multi-step tasks autonomously within set boundaries.
Requires constant human approval for each step.
questions.explanation: The narration states that an AI agent can execute multi-step tasks autonomously within set boundaries, unlike chatbots that only answer questions.

questions.text: AI regulation establishes guardrails to protect personal data and ensure transparency in automated financial decisions.
questions.explanation: The narration explains that regulation creates guardrails around data privacy, bias prevention, and transparent, auditable automated decisions.
